flowContents.comments: Self-healing test pack: Wide groups of 250, with decoys. Built by flows/build_all.py.
flowContents.name: nfh-p22-wide-250

processGroups.comments: The batch waits for 20,000 orders but its input connection holds only 10,000, so it empties only at its 30 minute bin age and the back pressure reaches ingest. (symptom: backpressure)
processGroups.name: S49 Order Merge Deadlock in 250 Processors

processGroups.comments: Malformed records fail and are routed back into the validator with no limit, so they pile up there for good, retried on every run. (symptom: failure_loop)
processGroups.name: S50 Failure Self-Loop in 250 Processors
